remarks: Perfectly positioned in one of Connecticut's most coveted communities, this classic 2-bedroom brick townhouse-style co-op offers the ultimate walk-to-town lifestyle in the heart of New Canaan. Timeless brick architecture and a traditional townhouse layout offer both charm and privacy, while the sun-filled interior features gracious living spaces and well-proportioned bedrooms designed for comfortable everyday living. Three beautifully finished floors. A wall of windows that lead to a beautiful private garden area. Detached garage. All this just steps from New Canaan's vibrant village wtih boutique shopping, fine dining, cafes, parks, and Metro-North train. This is an exceptional offering that delivers effortless access to everything that makes the town so special.  An outstanding opportunity!
